text.title: Blurred Roles and Team Evolution Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example: inputs → procedure steps → final artefact matching the JSON Schema in 02-output-contract.xml. Then: How to use role-persona subagents, audit patterns, and key gotchas when AI agents operate in overlapping-role zones.

section.title: Inputs (mocked)
section.note: Pulled per `## Prerequisites`; sources cited in `01-core-rules.xml` rationale.

section.title: Step-by-step application
section.note: 1. Preconditions check: all `## Applies If` items satisfied; no `## Skip If` items fired.
2. Inputs gathered from named sources; freshness OK.
4. Artefact produced from `templates/` rendered with real values (see Final Artefact below).

example.title: PM in three overlap zones
example.note: PM who can write SQL to validate a hypothesis, read a confusion matrix, and articulate a pricing model trade-off participates in all three overlap zones without creating handoffs.

example.title: Relay-runner PM
example.note: PM who writes a spec and hands it to design, then waits for a handoff from engineering to review, is operating as a relay runner — creating latency at every baton pass.

example.title: Diverge across four agents, human converges
example.note: Use brainstorm to spin a diverge phase across PM-agent, designer-agent, data-agent, and eng-agent on the same problem. Each agent produces only its disciplinary lens. The human DRI reads all four and makes the call.

example.title: Four agents with write access, no decision
example.note: Four subagents all given write access to the same PRD produce four contradictory PRDs and no decision. Always attach a converge step with a named human DRI.

section.title: Role-audit workflow

example.title: Audit prompt
example.code: Audit current team T against the blurred-roles model. For each member, list (a) primary discipline, (b) secondary fluencies, (c) overlap zones they participate in, (d) gaps. Output a CSV plus 3 prioritized SDD tasks to close the largest gap. Do not propose firing or restructuring.

section.reference: Emit per-author file-area distribution from git history to surface actual role boundaries
